The definition of an "Indie role-playing game" is not based on sales volume, distribution channels, or corporate backing. → *Mental reinforcement:* A game qualifies as "indie" not because it's cheap or obscure, but because the creators retained full creative control. This definition honors the creator’s vision and autonomy, placing the creator at the center of the identity of the game.
